positions.description:
Event Management

Provide proactive monitoring of all Cerner clients and Cerner Internal systems
Address alarms before they become incidents

Hands-on troubleshooting of all Cerner applications and architectures.

Monitoring Front End and Back End systems
Oracle, AIX, HP-UX, VMS, Linux, Citrix, Windows
Cerner Millennium Back-end, Cerner Millennium Applications, Doc Imaging, and Cerner Classic.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
Performed system administration duties: updating security protocols, imaging systems with end-user specified operating systems, network management policies, and development environment installations.
Implemented LANDesk Management Suite 9.0 software onto all networked systems and provided ongoing support.
Set up functional LANDesk Gateway Management system for users outside the wide area network (WAN) requiring remote assistance from technicians at the office.
Provided production support for Microsoft Windows Vista, XP and Windows 7. This included corporate windows policies and customizations. Also maintained Active Directory to keep accurate and updated information across all applications.
Trained and provided detailed documentation to senior level staff on products that others were unfamiliar with such as LANDesk Management Suite and Admin Studio.
System imaging and configuration process involved extensive knowledge of HP and Dell workstations and laptop hardware components as well as maintaining latest firmware revisions.
Automated tasks through silent unattended installs using scipting languages such as VBScript, and Admin Studio.
As an Intern, was given a hands-on opportunity with a number of appliances and programs to support the production environment. Cisco routers, switches, SAN storage technology, WLAN, DNS, Static IP’s  and DHCP networking configurations were among these learned.
Demonstrated self-starter work ethic by acquiring specific knowledge of LANDesk and  VMWare products for end-user management, and asset management utilities.
